brief: One local handoff as a playable game scene
prompt: Playable side-view sci-fi game screenshot, one local SpaceDonkey handoff. Earth curvature far below; a rigid backbone crosses high above. One unequal powered tether swing hangs from it. A small spacecraft is visibly mechanically locked to the moving carriage and riding its arc. Ahead is a second moving carriage with a broad translucent capture corridor. Show two faint projected release paths from the current craft: one early path misses below; one later tangent enters the next capture corridor. The scene must make the mechanic obvious by looking: wait, release, merge, lock, ride. No whole-planet explainer, no infographic panels, no literal jumping, no giant skyhook, no visible text, labels, logos, or watermark.
